findings.title: Universal base views exceed spike scope
findings.why_it_matters: Implementers must add and prove a system-wide abstraction for every application table even though R7 limits the spike to one five-table chatroom view. That extra universal contract expands the feasibility spike into partial generalization and adds work unrelated to demonstrating the agreed bounded vehicle; limiting it to the registered view preserves the intended minimal change set.
findings.suggested_fix: Change R17 and its Success Criteria counterpart to require implicit by_id and by_creation_time base-view definitions only for rooms, users, memberships, messages, and likes used by the pre-registered view; retain materialization and lifecycle validation only for those five tables.
evidence: The only accelerated view is a pre-registered, room-scoped recent-message feed
Every application table exposes implicit Skip base-view definitions corresponding to Convex's built-in by_id and by_creation_time indexes
Every application table exposes the two implicit base-view definitions, only the pre-registered view's five tables allocate their backing state

findings.title: Proof vehicle lacks executable query semantics
findings.why_it_matters: The spike cannot demonstrate R13's same-logical-version equivalence or R15's dependency-neighborhood scaling when the sole accelerated view has no specified result membership, ordering keys and tie-breaker, limit, or caller-dependent membership rule. Implementers can choose materially different feeds, yielding incomparable native baselines and maintained-state costs while each appears to satisfy the prose.
findings.suggested_fix: Choose and record the exact pre-registered native feed contract: caller identity and membership predicate, source-row eligibility, projection, deterministic ordering keys and tie-breaker, and result limit (and pagination behavior if applicable); use that contract for both the accelerated view and native oracle.
evidence: R7 defines only a pre-registered, room-scoped recent-message feed
R13 requires an independent native result for the same logical commit version
